text: Recovering interrupted prior-run work: a crashed/interrupted run may leave an issue's WIP in a git STASH (not only in the working tree or a bare branch) — run 'git stash list' before assuming work was reverted/lost. Note 'git checkout stash@{N} -- <files>' STAGES those files, so a later gh-as-agent commit of other work sweeps them in; unstash into a scratch area or reset the index if you need separate commits.

To integration-test a commit-making CLI's git behaviour (knowledge/gh-as-agent) without an ambient identity, run the real CLI as a subprocess inside a temp `git init` repo with a stripped identity: HOME=empty tmp dir, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/SYSTEM=os.devnull, and GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL popped from env.
